errors.text_span: Линията започва от точката (2003, 16), преминава през точките (2008, 17), (2013, 25), (2018, 40) и завършва в точката (2023, 57).
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly maps the data points to the x-axis gridlines. The blue line starts at (2003, 10), not (2003, 16). The value 17 is at approximately 2005, not 2008 (where the value is 14). The value 25 is at approximately 2014, not 2013. The line ends at approximately 2020 with a value of 57, it does not extend to 2023.
